mechanics.name: Spine Chill
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever the Killer looks at you within 40 metres, you are notified, cannot scream for 12 seconds, and vault 10% faster for 12 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30 seconds.
activation: The Killer looks at you while within 40 metres.
The perk is not on cooldown.
Ends/deactivates when: The scream-prevention and vault-speed effects end after 12 seconds.
Ends/deactivates when: The perk cannot trigger again during its 40/35/30-second cooldown.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Complete rework: when the Killer looks at you within 40 metres, gain a notification, 12 seconds of scream prevention, and 10% faster vaulting, with a 40/35/30-second cooldown.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: A nearby Killer looking at you triggers a warning, temporary scream immunity, and faster vaulting.

editorial.summary: When the Killer looks at you within 40 metres, gain a warning plus 12 seconds of scream immunity and 10% faster vaults.
useCases: Get an early warning when the Killer is looking at you within range.
Convert the opening of a chase into a short window of faster vaults.
Suppress screams during the active window against scream-based effects.
counters: The effect is temporary and then enters a cooldown, so it cannot cover every vault in a chase.
An early trigger can waste part of the 12-second window before a decisive vault occurs.
Its exact post-10.2 chase conversion still needs live data.
pros: Combines warning, scream suppression, and chase-relevant vault speed.
Much more directly chase-oriented than its old action-speed identity.
cons: Warning value overlaps normal Killer awareness in many matchups.
Exact rank remains provisional until post-10.2 play data exists.
analysis: Spine Chill was rebuilt into a chase-warning perk in 10.2. The old broad action-speed package is gone; instead, a Killer looking at you within 40 metres triggers a notification, twelve seconds of scream immunity, and 10% faster vaulting.

The vault bonus is the important competitive piece. Ten percent can alter close Window timings, and the trigger naturally occurs as the Killer notices or approaches you rather than requiring a manual activation.

The effect has a 40/35/30-second cooldown, so it cannot be permanent chase insurance. It also no longer speeds generators, healing, gates, or the many other actions associated with historical Spine Chill.
Modern Spine Chill deserves a fresh chase-based evaluation. It is narrower than the old generalist version but more directly useful during the moment a Killer is committing attention to you.
editorial.verdict: A cleaner 10.2 chase perk: warning, scream immunity, and 10% faster vaults when the Killer looks your way. The old action-speed identity is gone.
